correctness.rationale: A recurrence forces every endomorphism to be affine. Composition of right reflections and the order-at-most-two quotient H/2H give the exhaustive coset subquandle classification, including even moduli. Fixed slope implies exactly |U| respectful shifts. The braid coloring recurrence gives order r dividing gcd(n,k) and n phi(r) colorings. Multiplication u delta gives precisely (n/r) phi(s) slopes of image order s, and s versus n-s shifts determine the target layer and exact defect. The monomials differ by their t_(0,1) exponents. A fresh standalone finite verifier returned ALGEBRA_OK and GRADED_OK and VERIFY_OK after independently checking the cases it enumerates, which corroborate rather than substitute for the general proof.

value.rationale: For a polynomial invariant introduced in 2026, a universal all-link, all-filtration degeneracy theorem gives a mathematically motivated sharp boundary of the full-endomorphism enhancement. The complementary exact graded evaluation of all odd positive two-strand torus knots is a natural complete infinite parameter classification indexed by divisors; the contrast identifies what graded defect data preserve after ungraded collapse. The theorem is neither a single arbitrary finite census nor only a routine rebranding of a known coloring number.
